verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a one-line GitHub claim that agents have "their own audit trail" (buzz-gh-4). That is a first-party audit capability, but it covers agent actors only. The admin dashboard surfaces moderation reports and feedback, not an action log. missing for 10: documented workspace-wide audit log of admin and human user actions, an admin UI/API or export for reviewing audit events, documentation of what events are captured and how long they are retained, independent or hands-on corroboration.
